en.headline: HKUST president Nancy Ip receives UNESCO life sciences research prize
en.dek: The neuroscientist was honoured in Paris yesterday for work on Alzheimer’s biomarkers and blood tests that enable earlier diagnosis, becoming the sixth Chinese recipient of the award.
body: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology president and neuroscientist Nancy Ip has received the UNESCO–Equatorial Guinea International Prize for Research in the Life Sciences.

The award ceremony was held yesterday at UNESCO headquarters in Paris. The organisation recognised her contributions to understanding brain function and Alzheimer’s disease, including the discovery of new biomarkers and genetic risk factors, the development of blood tests for earlier diagnosis and monitoring, and pioneering work in gene therapy for neurodegenerative conditions.

Ip is the sixth Chinese scientist to receive the prize since it was established in 2008. Two other researchers, from Spain and Morocco, were also honoured this year for work on a tuberculosis vaccine and antimicrobial resistance respectively.

Speaking after the ceremony, Ip said many scientific advances depend on collaboration, particularly across disciplines, institutions and borders, and that stronger cooperation would be important for drug development against diseases such as Alzheimer’s.

zh.headline: 科大校長葉玉如獲教科文組織生命科學研究獎
zh.dek: 頒獎儀式昨日在巴黎舉行，表揚她在阿爾茨海默症生物標記及早期血液檢測方面的貢獻，成為第六位獲獎的中國科學家。
body: 香港科技大學校長、中國科學院院士葉玉如獲頒「聯合國教科文組織－赤道幾內亞國際生命科學研究獎」，表揚她在神經科學領域的傑出貢獻。
頒獎儀式昨日在聯合國教科文組織巴黎總部舉行。教科文組織指出，葉玉如在大腦功能及阿爾茨海默症研究方面取得重要成果，包括發現新的生物標誌物和遺傳風險因素、開發有助早期診斷及病情監測的血液檢測技術，以及在神經退行性疾病基因治療方面的開創性研究。
該獎項自2008年設立以來，葉玉如是第六位獲獎的中國科學家。同屆另外兩名得主分別來自西班牙及摩洛哥，因結核病疫苗及抗微生物藥物耐藥性研究獲獎。
葉玉如在典禮後表示，許多科研突破都離不開合作，尤其跨學科、跨機構及跨國界合作，這對阿爾茨海默症等疾病的藥物研發具有重要作用。
